title: Travel and Fitness
text: I enjoyed the flexibility of options across the city. In the end, I enjoyed a great Yoga session without having to buy a membership. It's perfect for people who travel around often. Would absolutely use it in other cities, too!
author: wararissat

title: Best fitness pass for travellers
text: Best option for travellers. I wanted to try some boutique studios for a bit of fun while exercising during my trip to Barcelona. This pass is the best option in town: i bought it in advance (I could cancel it any time before I used it!) and would not need to commit to a specific gym/studio.
author: Sergio_P

title: Now I know a bunch of places to train in Barcelona!
text: Having not spent much time here looking at gyms I was grateful that this pass had done the work for me.
author: ArinMelvin
